PHYSIOLOGY | TRANS 3
Cardiac Cycle
Lecture Date (08/12/2025) | Version 1
LEARNING OBJECTIVES
✔ To describe the phases of the cardiac cycle.
I. INTRODUCTION
● The cardiac cycle is the sequence of events in one heartbeat.
● This lecture follows the outline of the previous trans.
II. PHASES OF THE CARDIAC CYCLE
A. ATRIAL SYSTOLE
● Atrial contraction completes ventricular filling.
B. ISOVOLUMETRIC CONTRACTION
● All valves are closed while ventricular pressure rises.
III. HEART SOUNDS
● S1 marks closure of the atrioventricular valves.
